{{Top|leg}}
'''Hicco''' was a wild [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]]. He was the discoverer of the [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], which would later become one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
